note: Real events, verified 2026-08-28. Sources: score.org, pacesbdc.org, smallbusinessmajority.org, georgiasbdc.org, sbdcalbany.org. All online, all $0. Summaries written in-house.

events.title: Hiring Employees, Contractors or Family: Avoid Costly Tax and Payroll Mistakes
events.summary: Where the line sits between an employee and a contractor, what payroll rules follow from that, and what changes when the person you hire is family.

events.title: How to Build an AI Marketing Agent That Produces Better Content
events.summary: Turning a general AI tool into something that writes in your voice, and building a weekly rhythm around it instead of one-off prompts.

events.title: Build Your Holiday Marketing: Offers, Calendar and Content
events.summary: Getting Q4 offers and content mapped in September rather than scrambling in November.

events.title: Small Business Legal Clinic with Pro Bono Attorneys
events.summary: A virtual clinic where you sit with volunteer attorneys on your own situation: contracts, incorporation, IP, commercial leases. Run with the City Bar Justice Center.

events.title: Alternative Funding: Grants, Crowdfunding and More
events.summary: What is out there beyond a bank loan, and which routes actually fit a business at your stage.

events.title: Google Workspace with Gemini as a Productivity Partner
events.summary: Using Gemini inside Docs, Sheets and Gmail to analyze data and move work along without jumping between tools.

events.title: Intellectual Property Rights for Small Business
events.summary: Trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets and patents, what each actually protects, and the mistakes small operators tend to make first.

events.title: How a Graduated Income Tax Would Hit Colorado Small Businesses
events.summary: A breakdown of Colorado's Initiative 195 and what a shift away from a flat tax would mean for owners in the state. Q&A after, with Spanish interpretation.

events.title: Small Business Financial Management: Growth and Profitability
events.summary: Organizing the books, watching cash flow, and using business credit without digging a hole.

events.title: AI Exchange: Getting Ready to Actually Use AI
events.summary: Part of a monthly series alternating webinars and roundtables. This session is about building a strategy before you start buying tools.

events.title: Using AI for Financial Management Without Breaking the Books
events.summary: Where AI genuinely helps with business finances, what you still have to verify by hand, and why the bookkeeping underneath it has to be right.

events.title: Beyond the Barcode: Inventory, Retail Channels and Scaling
events.summary: How barcode and product data underpins inventory, ecommerce, and selling across more than one channel.

events.title: Finding the Financing Fit for Your Small Business
events.summary: Traditional lending against newer funding models, how to judge which fits your situation, and where the process usually snags. Supported by Wells Fargo.

events.title: Choosing the Right Business Entity
events.summary: Sole proprietorship, LLC and S-corp side by side, with the tax treatment and liability protection that comes with each.

events.title: Decoding Congress Heading Into the Midterms
events.summary: Their federal affairs team on the legislation moving before the election and what it changes for owners.

events.title: Emerging Technologies for Small Businesses and Startups
events.host: Pace University Lubin School of Business
events.summary: A professor's framework for spotting where AI, automation and IoT create real value in a small operation, without a large upfront spend.

events.title: Contract Basics for Small Business Owners
events.summary: How to build a contract, the provisions worth insisting on, and what your options are when the other side breaks one.
